name: Tyler Hoffman
action: Tyler hesitates, gripping the phone, then says, "I can't—I've got my first phlebotomy class at eight." He doesn't offer to find coverage or ask to call back, just stands there with the phone pressed to his ear.
reason: The coordinator's request collides with the class Tyler has been anticipating all week, triggering a flash of irritation and anxiety. Tyler's immediate concern is that skipping the first day would restart his pattern of letting commitments fade, and that worry outweighs the familiar impulse to just fill in. The hesitation in his response reflects that impulse still tugging at him, but the concrete fact of the class at eight keeps him from agreeing.
